messages:
mia: Heads-up — VelaHealth POC kickoff. Need to lock the throughput runbook + a price estimate. They want sustained ~600 QPS text-gen (avg ~25 tokens) + a mixed 400 QPS embeddings workload, 95th <120ms target. Also mandatory KMS/HSM for PHI. Can ops + security sync so I can give them a firm quote today? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: +1, I sketched a run plan below. Prefer Dedicated pool with a hosted-fallback policy. Steps: ramp 0->600 QPS over 15m, steady 2h, 3x 2m microbursts at 2x, 5m cooldowns. Embed traffic kept gated to avoid cache thrash. Will run per-region (us-east-1, eu-west-1) for latency/replication checks.

Locust snippet (quick):
```python
from locust import HttpUser, task, between
class GenUser(HttpUser):
    wait_time = between(0.01, 0.02)
    @task
    def gen(self):
        self.client.post('/v1/generate', json={'model': 'rwd-3b', 'prompt': '...','max_tokens':25})
```

sam: We'll record per-token cost and tail latency heatmaps. I can run a dry smoke today 16:00 PT if ops signs off.

alex_ops: Ops notes:
- Need pre-warm hooks for the dedicated pool (KV cache warm). Plan 20m warmup before steady-state.
- Autoscaler policy: target 70% GPU utilization, headroom for 2x microbursts via burst buffer.
- With external HSM we should measure additional RPC latency; schedule HSM toggle test during soak.

raj: Security checklist:
- VelaHealth requires FIPS-compatible KMS + audit non-repudiation. If they bring their HSM expect ~8-12ms extra per signing call; for high-qps gen that can add tail. Recommend envelope encryption so model I/O avoids per-request HSM roundtrip.
- Please have them complete the questionnaire: https://redwood.example/sec/questionnaire/velahealth (we need their networking diagram + KMS profile).

mia: Good call. Tess, for quote: they asked for committed capacity + burst headroom. Can you rough a monthly estimate so I can give them a ballpark? Also callout any enterprise discounts for 12mo commit.

tess: Rough numbers: baseline Dedicated (1x rwd-3b equivalent pool) + 25% burst buffer. Estimated run-rate ~ $36k/mo committed. Burst usage billed at 2x base unit while used — recommend quoting a capped burst budget to control cost. Add an enterprise add-on for enhanced observability + 99.9 SLA = +$4k/mo. Final price depends on model sizing and quantization; I can firm up if Sam shares exact token-rate logs from the smoke.

mia: Perfect. Raj, can you confirm if envelope encryption approach is acceptable for their compliance team?

raj: Yes, envelope encryption + audit logs should satisfy the ask. We'll still need their SOC2/ISO certs. If they insist on HSM in-path, note the latency delta in the SLO. I'll draft the security caveats in a short doc.

deploy-bot: [automation] dedicated-pool-velahealth prewarm job scheduled at 2026-03-23T23:45:00Z by @sam. Build: build-8842.

sam: I'll do the smoke at 16:00 PT, capture heatmaps (p50/p95/p99), token counts, and a short log artifact. Mia — confirm test window and I'll push the run results + a short writeup into the doc repo.

mia: Confirmed. 16:00 PT works. Please include raw artifacts + a 1-page executive summary for the customer. I'll loop in the account exec and legal after we have the security doc.

sam: Got it — will upload results to the shared drive and ping here once done.

mia: Thanks team :thumbsup:
